summary: byNordic Acquisition Corp (BYNO) filed an 8-K reporting an extension of its business combination deadline from May 12, 2026 to June 12, 2026. The company deposited $17,470 into its trust account to fund the one-month extension, as previously authorized by the board and shareholders. BYNO, a blank-check SPAC, has until August 12, 2026 to complete an initial business combination, with the board retaining discretion to further extend month-by-month. The filing includes a press release and forward-looking statements. Watch for announcement of a target or deal deadline; the low deposit suggests minimal cash remaining and urgency to execute a merger.
